notes.title: Art Upgrade Complete!
notes.notes: [p]The art revamp for our released chapters is finally complete! We typically use 3D-rendered placeholder environment art to set the vibe until we can get hand-drawn versions with all the custom details we want. And now those placeholders have all been replaced through Chapter 5![/p][p][/p][p]As for the next batch of chapters in the works, Ch 6-7 are undergoing edits thanks to beta feedback, and the Ch 8 beta version is on the way. As always, we welcome you to chat with us [url="https://discord.gg/EuDzqgh5"]on Discord[/url]![/p]

notes.title: Chapter 7 Beta Complete!
notes.notes:
[p]Chapter 7's visuals and audio are now in beta, so the entire chapter is now available for testing on our beta branch! (With the exception of voice acting, since that comes after beta ^.^ ) We also couldn't resist adding a couple more choices and a new spicy scene to Chapter 7 since our last update when the writing entered beta.

We also have more new art! Just 4 more drawings remain, and then all our released chapters will be 100% hand-drawn—no more 3D-rendered placeholders! From there on, all the new art will be for our upcoming, unreleased chapters.

As always, we welcome you to hang out with us on [url="https://discord.gg/XjqG7qzq"]Discord[/url], let us know what you think, and chat about what's coming![/p]

notes.title: Art upgrade now at 89%!
notes.notes:
We're back with another chunk of updated visuals, while chugging away at the new chapters in the background!

The dialogue and narration for Chapter 7 have now been thoroughly revised and moved from alpha into beta. Animations for Chapter 7 are in progress, and then it will appear in our private beta branch for those who signed up as testers!

Chapter 7 has been quite complex, with many ways to mix and match your choices regarding the two player characters' relationships. So it's satisfying to see all the combinations of possible past choices acknowledged in these new scenes.

As always, we welcome you to hang out with us on [url=https://discord.gg/x3vFgsw6]Discord[/url], let us know what you think, and chat about what's coming!

notes.title: Update 2025.02.28
notes.notes:
We now have 40 unique hand-drawn environments in the game, which means we are 74% complete with our effort to replace the 3D-rendered placeholders!

Finalizing our visuals, especially for the first few hours of the content, has been our top priority for the past several months. The motivation is to demonstrate the intended quality level for this project, especially to new people discovering us.

Meanwhile, editing proceeds on the next chapters to be released, turning the existing rough drafts of chapters 6-12 into beta drafts.

As always, we're happy to chat in more detail on [url=https://discord.gg/x3vFgsw6]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Update 2024.13.11
notes.notes:
We're now up to 32 hand-drawn environments, which is up 14 from the last update! Many of them include easter eggs and other interesting details that we had fun adding, so look closely, and you won't be disappointed! And even if you don't, you'll probably find that a lot of the game looks different than it did before.

This week is the 1-year anniversary of our release into Early Access, including chapters 1-5. Originally, we aimed to have our next batch of chapters ready for release after 1 year, but we're discovering just how much of an undertaking this game is as we go, from the art to the voice acting to all the choices we're scripting. Not to mention the next batch of chapters is bigger than the first! The flow of the narrative demands that we release chapters 6 through 12 together, so that's 7 chapters instead of 5.

Considering the above, we expect to share chapters 6 through 12 with you in 2025. More updates to come as we go! And we're happy to chat about the latest [url=https://discord.gg/x3vFgsw6]on Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Update 8/26
notes.notes:
We now have 18 hand-drawn environments, 6 of which are brand new since the last update! 

4 more pieces are already in the works, continuing to replace our 3D-rendered placeholder backgrounds with detailed art specific to our world and its characters.

Meanwhile, work on the next chapters continues! If you would be interested in beta testing, reach out to us [url=https://discord.gg/x3vFgsw6]on Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Update 6/4
notes.notes:
​We're working our way through all of the game's environment renderings, replacing Unreal-rendered placeholders with hand-drawn paintings. This update adds 9 more, for a total of 12!

We're also now nearly done with the beta version of Chapter 7, the second new chapter that will be included in the next batch of story content!

notes.title: Update 4/25
notes.notes:
We're continuing to add hand-drawn background art to replace the Unreal-rendered backgrounds we initially used!

We're working mostly chronologically through the game, so you can see updated intro dream visuals for Farkas, and updated visuals for Althea's home.

On the development side, we just completed the beta version of Chapter 6 and are moving forward with getting the rest of the next episodic release into beta as well.

notes.title: Hotfix 11/21
notes.notes:
We rooted out the remaining causes of a rare bug where unexpected character portraits would flash in the lower left corner of the screen during the transitions between lines of dialog or narration.

As mentioned in the previous hotfix, this bug became more and more rare as we took more precautions, but it was hard to be sure if it was gone because it was inconsistent, rare, and difficult to reproduce. But now, thanks to a save file that a player sent us where the bug had appeared, we were able to do extensive troubleshooting and come up with a fix that should eliminate the bug from existing bugged saves as well as prevent it from appearing again.

As a heads up, if you load a save file and find that it rolls you back to the beginning of the current chapter, this is a known issue with a recent update that had a (hopefully mild) effect on save compatibility if you open a save from before the update. Hopefully using Skip will quickly fast-forward you back to where you were, but apologies for the inconvenience! Updates going forward shouldn't cause this.

As always, if you run into any issues, we love to receive feedback via:
Discord: https://discord.gg/cWRmscgemr

Twitter: https://twitter.com/godsoftwilight

email: info@volutian.com

notes.title: Rare Bugs and their Fixes
notes.notes:
The glitch we mentioned [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1528970/view/5912724862968456333?l=english]in this previous announcement[/url] appears to be very rare but may still occur! It appears to be a long-standing issue with the game engine we use, which happens so rarely that it's been difficult to root out since we can't reliably reproduce it. We have [url=https://github.com/renpy/renpy/issues/5131]an issue open[/url] with the engine's devs to resolve it, so all bug reports from users will help with that!

In the meantime, we've found that the glitch is gone if you start a new game and fast-forward using Skip back to where you left off. Apologies for the inconvenience--We'll update with announcements here as we continue to troubleshoot.

There was another bug reported where loading a save file would roll the game back to the beginning of the chapter. This can happen after Chapter 0 with saves made before a recent update to the game, when they are opened after that update. This shouldn't happen with saves made from now on.

If anyone runs into issues, we love to receive feedback via:
[url=https://discord.gg/cWRmscgemr]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/godsoftwilight]Twitter[/url]
email: info@volutian.com

notes.title: Hotfix 11/17
notes.notes:
There was a bug causing the wrong character portraits to briefly appear next to the textbox on rare occasions.

The way we had been using character portraits during some choice menus was causing this to happen, and we've removed all instances of this.

NOTE: If you have a save file where you were experiencing this issue, that particular file may still have the bugged character portrait saved as part of its game state, because that save still has in its history that it was exposed to the bugged menu portrait setting before the fix. Saves that never experienced this bug, as well as new saves, should remain unaffected by it. The fastest way to get back to where an affected save left off would be to use the Skip button to fast-forward up to that point. Apologies for the inconvenience!

notes.title: New Steam game is Cyberpunk 2077 meets Smite, with Genshin's YaoYao
notes.notes:
In the neon-bathed world of Cyberpunk 2077, the Gods and Goddesses of ancient times feel pretty archaic. Where technology reigns supreme and myth has been banished to the annals of history, imagining a mashup of CDPR's Night City and Smite's fantastical setting is pretty difficult - unless you're the team at Volutian Design, that is.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Gods of the Twilight is Out Now!
notes.notes:
The time has come to face your destiny! Today we release the first five chapters of our cyberpunk visual novel Gods of the Twilight in Steam Early Access.
[list]
[*] Discover magic in a world of tech
[*] Shape the coming apocalypse
[*] Make friends, enemies, and (optionally) lovers
[*] Fully voiced dialog!
[/list]
[previewyoutube=s_onpcoOiXQ;full][/previewyoutube]
This multi-season, episodic adventure follows the journeys of dual protagonists Althea and Farkas as old Norse magic returns to their world, and they realize they're more than human.

Faced with unexpected abilities and assassins hunting them for just that reason, they must flee their homes on the city-ship of New Reykjavík and look elsewhere for safety and answers. In the process, they will face gods, monsters, and humans on all sides of the law who could become friends, enemies, or even lovers.

With hundreds of variables tracking your choices and countless combinations of consequences, you decide what becomes of the characters, their relationships, and their apocalypse. How will you end the world?

Early Access will grant you:
[list]
[*] Immediate access to the first 5 chapters (about 10 hours per playthrough including the demo Chapter 0)
[*] Automatic access to the remaining chapters of Season 1 as we add them, at no additional charge
[/list]
Season 1 is planned to include 20 chapters, and new sets of 5-6 chapters are planned every 6-12 months.

notes.title: We are Steam Deck Compatible!
notes.notes:
We've requested an official Steam Deck Compatibility Review by Valve, but in the meantime, we tested the game on Deck ourselves.

It includes:
[list]
[*] Full controller support
[*] No platform-specific glyphs to display
[*] No text input requiring a keyboard
[*] Runs at a playable framerate on Deck by default
[*] The smallest font size is 14
[*] No crashes or freezing observed by the devs during play on Deck
[/list]
However, if you experience any issues, please don't hesitate to reach out! We're happy to receive feedback via:
[url=https://discord.gg/RTjgytenXc]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/godsoftwilight]Twitter/X[/url]
